About.title: I build bridges between code and business outcomes
About.intro: I'm a systems engineer specialized in tech solutions for the Latin American market. I combine global technical rigor with deep understanding of local context to ship software that solves real problems.

mission.title: Solve local problems with international standards
mission.body: Design and build software that raises the technical bar of the LatAm market without losing sight of the real needs and constraints of end users.

vision.title: Tech as a lever for social mobility
vision.body: A solid digital ecosystem lets people and companies in the region compete globally. My work aims at enabling that lever.

values.title: Rigor, transparency, product over hype
values.body: I prefer a boring solution that works over a brilliant demo that breaks. I document, measure, and learn out loud.

ambitions.title: Build a boutique LatAm software studio
ambitions.body: Build a small, senior team that ships B2B products with international standards — without the overhead of traditional consultancies.

Projects.title: Case Studies
Projects.eyebrow: Solutions that generate measurable business outcomes
Projects.description: Each project represents a deep collaboration where I apply technical expertise to solve specific business challenges, with emphasis on measurable results and long-term sustainability.

Services.title: Specialized Services

Services.description: I build technology that combines global technical rigor with deep understanding of the Latin American context, focused on measurable business outcomes and long-term sustainability.
